Publish that immutable closeout head through exact-head verification, independent review, all checks including a non-empty required subset, zero actionable threads, normal merge or the bounded approval-only admin fallback, cleanup, final main...origin/main 0 0, clean worktree, and external reporting only.
requiredCommandTokens: Betroffene Skripte und Dokumente / Affected scripts and documents
gates.rationale: The feature-PR primary-evidence checkpoint occurs before its own merge and main synchronization, so claiming causal closeout completion here would assert mutable future facts. The separate closeout transaction remains mandatory and fail-closed after the feature merge.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Immediately after the feature PR is merged and local main is fast-forward synchronized, before creating or committing the exact three-path closeout transaction.

gates.requiredScope: Product build, unit, integration, runtime, performance, and architecture tests.
gates.rationale: META-LH-01 changes documentation and workflow evidence only. The feature-local Python acceptance contract is validation tooling, not product code, runtime, architecture, or a product command surface.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Re-evaluate if product code, runtime, scaffold, architecture, parser, generator, or executable product behaviour enters scope.

gates.requiredScope: Dependency, SBOM, VEX, SLSA, AI-SBOM, package, build-provenance, and release validation.
gates.rationale: The standard-library acceptance contract adds no external dependency, package, binary, AI runtime, build, or release artefact.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Re-evaluate at any dependency, component, AI-runtime, build, package, publication, or release handoff.

gates.requiredScope: New or changed Bash and PowerShell product scripts, man pages, cmdlets, dry-run behaviour, and platform-specific product validation.
gates.rationale: No Bash or PowerShell script, product CLI, cmdlet, man page, or platform-specific product behaviour changes. The bounded Python contract uses only the standard library and validates both installed Bash and PowerShell surfaces where required.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Re-evaluate if a Bash/PowerShell script pair, product CLI, cmdlet, man page, or platform-specific product behaviour is added, changed, or removed.

gates.requiredScope: Shared agent guidance, templates, constitution, presets, preset promotion, and level-0 synchronization.
gates.rationale: The accepted scope excludes all shared guidance, templates, constitution, preset mutation or promotion, level-0 changes, and Home Sync. The installed preset-version delta audit is recorded read-only in autonomous-run-state.json and plan.md; no version changes.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Re-evaluate if shared guidance, templates, constitution, preset metadata, promotion, level-0 content, or Home Sync enters scope.
